note: Alberta Parks recreation area at Ghost Reservoir, ~18 km W of Cochrane on Hwy 1A, run under contract by Ghost Lake Recreations (marina and chandlery on site); grassy sites and larger pads for RVs and tents, with a boat launch and beach for boating and windsurfing. Alberta Parks says the hand-pump water is not safe to drink; the operator lists potable water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 80 unserviced FCFS sites at C$31 (now manual); facilities: outhouses, no flush toilets, derived showers cleared; season conflict (agency Oct 13 vs operator Oct 15) flagged; recommend lakefront -> lakeview and a pin move to the main loop.
flags: WATERFRONT - recommend downgrade lakefront -> lakeview. The ~80-spur fishbone campground in imagery sits NORTH of Hwy 1A (centre ~51.2203,-114.7195; Google's PRA pin 51.2217715,-114.7179847 is on that side); its nearest spurs are ~190 m from the reservoir with the highway between. The stored pin / Alberta Parks campground marker (51.217297,-114.720063) is on a gravel loop along the shore south of the highway, 15-45 m from the water over open ground; whether that loop holds campsites (a few clear waterfront sites = waterfront with a caveat) is not stated on any page. Operator's 'Situated on the water's edge' / 'camp right by the lake' is marketing prose and cannot earn the value. Unsure after every source -> lakeview.
